body.citation: Zeng, Z., Balakrishnan, S., Han, Y., and Kennedy, E. H. (2024; revised 2026). Causal inference with high-dimensional discrete covariates. arXiv:2405.00118v3, especially Theorem 2 on pages 8--10, Appendix A.1, Appendix C.5, Appendix D.2, Section 6, and the Discussion. Theorem 2 is stated for the one-arm functional \(\psi_1\), and its proof sets the control-arm regression to zero.
